images.title: Coins that balance a weight
images.purpose: Shows a balance with a 45 kg weight against a heap of 1-rupee coins of about 4 g each, about 11250 coins.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One simple balance scale in the centre with one pan on each side.
images.exact_structure: One simple flat balance scale in dark outline, level. On the left pan, one teal (#0072B2) block labelled 45 kg = 45000 g. On the right pan, exactly 5 equal stacks of plain amber (#E69F00) coins, each stack exactly 10 thin flat discs with no markings, 50 discs in all, standing for a very large pile. Above the right pan the label 1 coin ≈ 4 g. Under the scale, in reddish purple (#CC79A7), the label 45000 ÷ 4 = 11250 coins. Exactly 1 block and 5 coin stacks. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Number of coins is the weight divided by the weight of one coin.
images.description: Shows a balance with a 45 kg weight against a heap of 1-rupee coins of about 4 g each, about 11250 coins.

image_decisions.why: The balance shows the model behind the estimate: total weight over one coin's weight.
